base_group: combined_001 from the retained five-group experiment
estimator: Per-channel median source linear RGB divided by median reference-render linear RGB within the same fixed polygon; channel-wise clamp to [0.6,1.1]
intervention: One spatially constant linear-RGB multiplier in each isolated target material's existing base-color chain
parameter_provenance: assumed source-fitting prior, not measured reflectance
primary_metric: RGB MAE in the previously fixed bedding ROI; compare unchanged combined base against the prescribed one-shot candidate
secondary_metric: Mean absolute log linear-luminance ratio using epsilon 0.0001
limits: Same-image fitting diagnostic. Coarse ROI performance is not independent texture reconstruction, real material identification, complete visual acceptance or SOTA. Keep a failed or worse proposal.
